# BTicino C300X Integration v2.5.1

## 2026-11-19

Version 2.5.1 adds C300X firmware `2.0.2` and makes the first installation
work on a rooted stock device. It contains no other changes to 2.5.0.

## Firmware 2.0.2

- C300X firmware `2.0.2` is supported in addition to `1.7.x`. The routing
  patch knows the `2.0.2` build of its target; the agent binary and the
  display files are the same for both firmware versions.
- Ring Call on `2.0.2` is not yet confirmed on a device.
- Thanks to @davemajor for the routing table and the firmware analysis.

## Fixed

- The installation on a rooted stock device no longer needs extra Python
  modules on the C300X. The installer ran Python there, and the stock Python
  lacks `json` and `hashlib`, so the installation stopped with
  `device_install_failed`.

## Update

The native agent changed. After updating the integration, run the agent-update
Repair so the device gets agent `2.5.1`.
